name: @fezchat/mining
description: Mine any Bittensor subnet from fez — harness, CLI, and GUI.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import{createRequire as ___fezMiningCreateRequire}from'module';const require=___fezMiningCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=dist && esbuild src/run-main.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import{createRequire as ___fezMiningCreateRequire}from'module';const require=___fezMiningCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/run.js && esbuild src/gui.tsx --bundle --format=iife --global-name=__fezExt --platform=browser --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=h --outfile=dist/gui.js && esbuild src/headless.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import{createRequire as ___fezMiningCreateRequire}from'module';const require=___fezMiningCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/headless.js && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/mcp.js
